title: 七月（节选）
author: 佚名（《诗经·豳风》）
authorEn: Anonymous (Book of Songs, Airs of Bin)
intro: A farmer’s calendar sung some 3,000 years ago: the Fire Star sinks in the sky, the cold winds come, and in spring the whole family goes out to the fields. This opening stanza is the start of the longest farming song in the Book of Songs.
analysis: 《七月》是《诗经》里最长的一首农事诗，共八章，一个月一个月地唱农家一年的活儿，像一本唱出来的农家日历。这里选的是第一章。开头“七月流火”说的是天上的大火星（心宿二）往西落下去，表示暑热过去、秋天快到了——不是说七月热得像火，今天很多人这样误用。接着从寒冬写到开春：冬天风冷刺骨，没有衣服怎么熬过年底？天一暖，就修好农具下地，妻子孩子把饭送到田头，管农事的官看了也高兴。诗里的“一之日、二之日”是周代的历法，大约相当于农历的十一月、十二月。全章没有一句直接抒情，只是一件件写农活和天气，却让人感到农民对季节的敏感、过冬的忧虑和春耕的忙碌。读它，像看到三千年前中国乡村的真实生活。
analysisEn: “The Seventh Month” is the longest farming song in the Book of Songs: eight stanzas that walk month by month through a farming family’s year, like a calendar you can sing. This is the first stanza. The famous opening 七月流火 does not mean “July is as hot as fire”, a common modern misreading. 火 is the Fire Star (Antares), and 流 means it is sliding west and down the sky — a sign that summer is ending and autumn is near. So in the ninth month, warm clothes are handed out. The song then jumps into the hard months: biting winds, bitter cold, and the worry of having no proper clothes to last the year. Then spring: the ploughs are mended, people step into the fields, wives and children carry food out to the workers, and the official in charge of the farms is pleased. The odd phrases 一之日, 二之日 (“the days of the first, the second”) use the Zhou calendar, roughly the eleventh and twelfth months of the later lunar calendar. There is no line of open feeling here — only weather and work — yet you sense how closely these people watched the sky, how they feared the winter, and how busy spring was. It is one of the best windows we have onto daily life in ancient China.
background: The Book of Songs gathers 305 songs from roughly the 11th to the 6th century BC; most authors are unknown. This one belongs to the “Airs of Bin” (豳风), from the area of present-day Shaanxi where the Zhou people are said to have farmed before founding their dynasty.
pronunciation: 觱发 bì bō：“发”按旧注读 bō（形容寒风），也有注本读 fā，当前采用 bì bō。栗烈 lì liè；褐 hè；卒岁 zú suì；耜 sì；馌 yè；田畯 tián jùn；南亩 nán mǔ。“一之日”的“一”逐字注本调 yī。
version: 采用通行的《毛诗》文本。《七月》全诗八章、八十八句，这里只选第一章（十一句）。“栗烈”有的版本作“栗冽”。网站按两个分句一行排版，最后一行三个分句。

lines.py: qī yuè liú huǒ, jiǔ yuè shòu yī
lines.lit: In the seventh month the Fire Star sinks west; in the ninth month clothes are handed out.
lines.en: In the seventh month the Fire Star slides down the sky; by the ninth, it is time to hand out warm clothes.

lines.zh: 一之日觱发，二之日栗烈。
lines.rhythm: 一之日/觱发，二之日/栗烈
lines.py: yī zhī rì bì bō, èr zhī rì lì liè
lines.lit: In the days of the first month the wind blows cold; in the days of the second, the air is bitter.
lines.en: Then comes the month of howling wind, then the month of biting cold.
lines.tts: 一之日必波，二之日栗烈。

lines.py: wú yī wú hè, hé yǐ zú suì
lines.lit: Without clothes, without coarse wool — how can we reach the end of the year?
lines.en: No clothes, not even rough wool — how will we last out the year?

lines.zh: 三之日于耜，四之日举趾。
lines.rhythm: 三之日/于耜，四之日/举趾
lines.py: sān zhī rì yú sì, sì zhī rì jǔ zhǐ
lines.lit: In the days of the third month we mend the ploughs; in the days of the fourth, we lift our feet into the fields.
lines.en: In the third month we fix our ploughs; in the fourth we step out into the fields.
lines.tts: 三之日于寺，四之日举趾。

lines.zh: 同我妇子，馌彼南亩，田畯至喜。
lines.rhythm: 同我/妇子，馌彼/南亩，田畯/至喜
lines.py: tóng wǒ fù zǐ, yè bǐ nán mǔ, tián jùn zhì xǐ
lines.lit: With my wife and children, we bring food to those southern fields; the field officer comes and is glad.
lines.en: Wives and children carry meals out to the southern fields, and the overseer comes by, smiling.
lines.tts: 同我妇子，业彼南亩，田俊至喜。

words.note: 火：大火星；流：向西落下。今天常被误用来形容天气炎热。

words.en: the days of the first month (Zhou calendar)
words.note: 周历的正月，约相当于农历十一月；二之日约是十二月，以此类推。
现代汉语“凛冽”意思相近。
古代穷人穿的粗布衣；今天“褐”多指颜色（褐色）。

words.en: to get through to the end of the year

words.note: 耜：古代翻土的农具，像锹。

words.en: to lift one’s feet — to go out and plough
to bring food to people working in the fields

words.note: 古诗里常用来泛指农田。

imagery.name: 星
imagery.zh: 大火星西沉，是农民看天知季节的标志：夏天要结束了，该准备冬衣了。
imagery.en: The Fire Star sinking west is how farmers read the season from the sky: summer is over, time to get ready for winter.

imagery.name: 风
imagery.zh: 冬天呼呼的寒风，写出没有冬衣的人对冬天的害怕。
imagery.en: The howling winter wind shows how frightening the cold is for people without warm clothes.
